_comment: Chimora shop offers. The only source for offers (docs/MONETIZATION.md). Prices: rg_price in Riftglass (0 = not for Riftglass), eur_cents = direct store price tier; the shop always shows the price text the store sends. Server copy: tools/shop/build_offers_sql.py.

advantage_values._comment: Pay-to-win step 1 (Ali, 10 Nov 2026). Seal tiers in percent (ShopEffects.seal_percent), crystal_cap = most crystal points per stat (twice Spirling.SPARK_MAX), growth_plus = extra growth of the Growth Seal. Step 3: ring_cap_plus = extra Rings over the Ring cap with the Ring Cap Seal.
